text:
Gold Price in 2014
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2014, the LBMA gold price fell 3.6% between 2014-01-31 ($1,251) and 2014-12-30 ($1,206). The highest sampled price was $1,327 in February and the lowest was $1,164 in October. The mean of these observations was $1,255. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
